card.text: A Cepheid in the Triangulum Galaxy, 840 kiloparsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 8.11 days.

sources.label: Breuval et al. (2023), ApJ 951 118 2023

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope measured its brightness in three colours; its pulsation takes 8.11 days. Its galaxy's distance, 840 kiloparsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
